rationale: Lisa brings deep expertise in XR/AR enterprise strategy and AI integration for industrial clients—exactly the domain space where haptic feedback could unlock the next generation of immersive enterprise tools. Diego is building Haptic AI, a complementary technology that pairs naturally with the extended reality and robotics work Lisa is delivering to automotive and industrial manufacturers. Both are based in San Francisco and positioned at the intersection of AI and immersive tech, making this a strong technical and market fit.
intro_message: Lisa Wang, meet Diego Prats — you're both building at the convergence of AI and immersive technologies, and haptic feedback could be a key piece of the industrial XR solutions Lisa is deploying with her enterprise clients.
